part: Mobile 390 — Watchlist list surface (top bar, masthead, 2x2 band tiles, chip-group strip, two-line rows)
artboards: 11-watchlist (desktop); mobile-390 text spec (no 390 artboard PNG exists yet)
source: docs/design/handoff-2026-09-06/DEVIATION-LOG.md 'MOBILE 390 SPEC' (Claude Design, delivered by the operator 2026-09-07), sections TOP BAR / MASTHEAD / BAND TILES / LIST ROW / FILTERS. No artboard PNG for 390 has reached the repo; the text spec is the binding source until one does, and when one arrives the image wins and the differences are logged.
notes: Same mount as the compose-* spec for this surface, at 390 instead of 1440. The mobile 390 spec's own framing is 'No new components. Every part is the desktop part at a smaller measure', so a second mount would duplicate one that already exists.

`compiledCss: true` is required on every mobile-* spec: AppShell/Sidebar/TopBar express the desktop/mobile switch as Tailwind utility classes (`hidden md:flex`, `md:hidden`), which the raw globals.css read the 1440 specs use leaves un-expanded. Opt-in per spec so the 43 green 1440 specs on the same mounts are not re-baselined. See run-audit.mjs at the addStyleTag call.
Rows below 768 drop the 76px timeline column and nothing else; every other cell of the desktop row is still measured here, at its mobile measure.

The rail folds under the content (one grid track below 1280), which is the spec's BREAKPOINTS behaviour; the rail's FILTERS card specifically is not drawn, because the mobile spec designs its own single filter surface (the chip-group strip plus the Filters sheet) and two live controls over the same facets is the duplication CLAUDE.md rule 13 forbids.

This mount is the page component itself (the same one its compose-* spec measures), not the AppShell frame, so the TOP BAR and DRAWER regions are measured once by mobile-01-dashboard.json and mobile-18-drawer.json rather than repeated on all five surfaces.

`.cl-facets-desktop` and `.cl-list-row-header` are asserted as forbids rather than as hidden elements here: the list surfaces do not render either at any width (the desktop facet strip was retired when the filters moved to the rail; the column header is a dashboard/watchlist card part), so a `display: none` expectation would report NOT BUILT rather than the truth.

The watchlist artboard (11/id="p11") draws no band tile row and no facet chip strip: its facets live in the rail's FILTERS card. Those regions are therefore not asserted here, and the rail card is asserted PRESENT rather than hidden.

children.name: Masthead wrapper carries no desktop side padding at 390 (the masthead's own 16px is the page margin)
Masthead title Anton 24px uppercase, line-height 1.08, margin-top 5px
Masthead row stacks so the command bar takes a full-width line of its own
The Cmd-K hint is dropped at 390
Content container padding 14px 16px 16px, one column below 768
The rail FILTERS card IS drawn at 390 on the watchlist (its only filter surface) and folds under the content
children.note: The other four list surfaces hide this card below 768 because they render the mobile chip strip and the Filters sheet instead. The watchlist renders neither, so hiding it would leave the page with no filter surface at all at 390 — logged in DEVIATION-LOG.md as a coordinator default. The shell gates the hide rule on its own --mobile-facets class.

Tier square 9.5px/800 .06em in a 1px rgba(0,0,0,.2) radius-4 box
Overflow control is a 44x44 target with a left rule
children.note: 'Pushed right' is measured by the boundsCheck below, not by margin-left: getComputedStyle resolves `auto` to a used pixel value.

children.name: The 76px timeline column is the only thing dropped at this width

forbid.name: no literal UNSCORED token anywhere
forbid.reason: Operator ruling P1 2.1: unscored renders a 30px dashed baseline plus the small-caps absence reason, never this literal.

forbid.name: no NOT SCORED wording
forbid.reason: Mobile 390 spec, LIST ROW: 'never a second row, never "NOT SCORED"'.

forbid.name: no bare fabricated 0/12 impact sum on an unscored row
forbid.reason: An unscored row renders the Absence convention, never a fabricated zero (regex, not substring, so a real 10/12 is not a false finding).

forbid.name: no floating Ask AI control
forbid.reason: Operator ruling P1 2.2: the masthead command bar is the ask; no floating control, at any width.

forbid.name: no desktop facet chip strip in the content column at any width
forbid.reason: Operator audit 2026-09-07: the facet strip that used to sit above the rows in the content column is gone at every width; the mobile chip-group strip is a different element (.cl-facets-mobile).

boundsCheck.name: no list-row cell overlaps a sibling or escapes its row at 390
boundsCheck.reason: Same defect class at the narrowest supported width; 375 must not clip, so 390 must have headroom.

boundsCheck.name: nothing in the content column is wider than the content column
boundsCheck.reason: MOBILE-60 regression guard: the watchlist built its own copy of the shell's frame and so carried none of the mobile page measures until this lane; it now renders the shell's own exported block.
